criterion: At least 5 event groups, 10 event cells and 5 pre-event risk cells; >=5% lower median MAE against four baselines with all 98.75% paired group CI upper bounds below zero, Brier <= HGB +0.02, misses no worse than HGB or unanchored censor AFT, and coverage drop <=5 points.
limits: KIT development assessment, not unopened confirmation groups or cross-dataset transfer.
Known-event MAE and coverage exclude censored query outcomes; all queries retained in prediction file.
Four-week Brier excludes only horizons whose outcome is unknowable; this selection is not necessarily censor-unbiased.
Immediate measurement-end availability is assumed, not actual report-arrival time.
Censoring may be informative; the existing literature combines slope and survival and no novelty is claimed.
